visual.name: pillToggleSlicer
visual.description: Horizontal pill-style single-select slicer. Applies a basic filter on the bound column and supports an optional default selection that reapplies when the filter is cleared.

en-US.Landing_Body: Bind a column to the Field bucket - each distinct value becomes a pill. Works best with two to six values, such as a period or scenario switch.
